subject.title: feat: per-job elevated exec scoping for cron and heartbeat

question: Should elevated cron and heartbeat authority be solved with narrow per-job markers now, or folded into a broader Gateway-owned non-forgeable provenance model?
rationale: The remaining work changes host-exec authority and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent trust model or compatibility policy without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Fold Into Provenance Design
options.body: Use this issue as the elevated-exec slice of the broader schedule and heartbeat provenance model, with execution receipts and heartbeat authority covered explicitly.

options.title: Implement Narrow Elevated Markers
options.body: Add per-job and heartbeat elevated authority fields now, but require explicit create, update, execution audit, and migration semantics before implementation.

options.title: Document Wildcard Risk Temporarily
options.body: Defer code changes and document the current wildcard risk while preserving existing trusted unattended workflows until the broader model is ready.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Provenance Design
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the elevated-exec slice of the broader schedule and heartbeat provenance model, with execution receipts and heartbeat authority covered explicitly.
